phases.description: All production service constructors receive PersistenceGateway rather than DatabaseService.
Gateway transaction API supports atomic multi-collection work with rollback on failure.
Runtime readiness endpoint inventories persisted collections and shape fingerprints.
Implement managed relational adapter behind the existing contract.
Map JSON collections/documents to normalized relational tables and constraints.
Deterministic source manifests and count/hash verification framework are complete; target adapter/backfill execution remains future.
Compare managed-store reads to incumbent store without serving managed data.
Write both stores with mismatch alarms and authoritative JSON rollback.
Promote managed store after human certification.
Retain reversible cutover until managed-store observation window passes.

verification.sourceManifest: SHA-256 per store plus total record count
